name: Elton Manor: Requiem of the Cursed Roses
detailed_description:
◆ Story

"Rumors, huh..."
"It must be that one, right?"
"Actually... the master once had a lover."

In the early 20th century, within a secluded manor untouched by the chaos of the times, a "maid" named Anna diligently carries out her daily tasks, living a monotonous yet peaceful life.



However, an unexpected recollection stirs a void in Anna's memory, swallowing him whole. Unusual behavior from colleagues, a confused sense of gender, fragmented awareness, and hazy dreams—what was once a peaceful existence is now overshadowed by an eerie atmosphere. Just as Anna struggles to make sense of it all, time begins to move again, and a group of unfamiliar visitors arrives at the manor, quietly unraveling a long-hidden mystery.



As the curtain rises, an orchestrated series of unexpected events unfolds. The so-called relatives of the manor's owner display blatant inconsistencies—conflicting identities, ages, and relationships. Do these contradictions connect to the unease they exude? Words that should not exist begin to echo in Anna’s mind—what role do they play in this story?

With the stage set and fate in motion, will "Anna" be pushed to the unknown fringes of reality, or will they be drawn into the very heart of the story’s vortex?

◆ Gameplay

☆ Work:
The mansion is crawling with black devils skittering through the shadows—you must take matters into your own hands to get rid of them!
If you’re too slow to react, they’ll start running wild through the house!
Each stage increases in difficulty and unlocks new, unique mini-games.
Keep an eye out—there are hidden Easter eggs scattered throughout your tasks, just waiting to be discovered!

☆ Map Exploration:
As time passes, new areas of the manor will gradually become accessible, inviting you to explore further.
Aside from your main objectives, curiosity is your best guide—there’s much to uncover:
★ Entertaining dialogues
★ Characters hiding secrets

And more awaits ⭢
☆ Case Investigation:
A string of murders plagues the manor, and danger lurks beneath the surface.
Each character hides their own secrets, and the truth lies buried in subtle clues…
You must collect evidence, piece together the mystery, and reconstruct crime scenes to uncover the lies.
Will you expose the truth—or go with the flow?
The choice is yours. Don’t be fooled by appearances.



◆ Game Features

☆ A layered mystery narrative built on intricate clues, with 3 bonus side stories!
☆ Over 25 CGs and illustrations to collect
☆ Cleaning, chatting, map exploration, and even the option to romance NPCs
☆ Enjoy complex, twist-filled stories featuring rich male-male dynamics!
☆ Three top voice actors bring each protagonist to life with versatile vocal performances, delivering the ultimate immersive experience!

short_description: In the early 20th century, "maid" Anna worked diligently in a quiet manor. After an accident, lost memories surfaced—strange colleagues, a blurred identity, and hazy dreams... As she wavered in confusion, mysterious visitors arrived, unraveling a long-buried secret.
